# Checkout · implementation plan

Scope: the checkout page on **phones** on web and mobile, UI-first (mock-DI).

## Steps
1. Lock the contract (`contracts/checkout.md`): done.
2. Web: `Pages/Checkout` (6 files) against Figma `2231:884`.
3. Mobile: `Views/CheckoutView` (5 files), same frame.
4. Reconcile both against the contract by requirement ID.

| Point | Owner | State |
|---|---|---|
| Empty-state copy | design | waiting |
| Timer rounding | web + mobile | agreed: whole seconds |

> Phase stays UI-first: no Gateway wiring in this round.
